OPENCLAW_WORKERS_LEAKING: OpenClaw on Oracle has more Codex app-server workers than agents (the duplicate-worker leak, LIFE-531).
Restart the OpenClaw gateway when no agent run is in progress; see LIFE-531.
ORACLE_BOOT_BACKUPS_FULL: Oracle boot-volume backups are at their limit of 5, so the next weekly backup of the Edge would be refused (LIFE-808).
Delete the oldest boot-volume backup you no longer need in the Oracle console.
ORACLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The Oracle Cloud card has no configuration.
ORACLE_OFF_CONTRACT: Oracle's stats did not match the contract.
ORACLE_READBACK_MISMATCH: The card did not read back as written.
ORACLE_STALE: Oracle's stats are older than the freshness limit.
ORACLE_UNREACHABLE: The Oracle stats endpoint could not be reached.
ORACLE_WRITE_FAILED: The card could not be written to Notion.
AT_RISK: The Oracle instance reclaim state is AT_RISK.
CONCORD_BAD_FRAME: The Concord helper got a request that was not the fixed `concord1` line.
CONCORD_CLI_MISSING: The Concord command-line tool is missing for the concord user on Oracle.
Reinstall the Concord CLI for that account; the row stays on its last good read for 2.5 hours.
CONCORD_READ_FAILED: The Concord command-line tool exited with an error.
Check the concord account's workspace; the next tick asks again.
CONCORD_TIMEOUT: The Concord command-line tool did not answer in 25 seconds.
CONCORD_BAD_OUTPUT: The Concord command-line tool's listing was not the expected message records.
Compare the Concord CLI version with lifeos/inbox/concord_source.py.
CONCORD_UNREACHABLE: The private endpoint could not be asked for the Concord reading, or answered off contract.
Check the endpoint and the Concord helper socket on Oracle.
